Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn Vale District Office The Vale District of the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) manages 5.1 million acres of public land in eastern Oregon. The district boundary runs along the Snake River between Oregon and Idaho and includes small sections of both Washington and Nevada. The district is split into two Field Offices, Baker and Malheur . The Malheur Field Office staff are located at the District Office in Vale, Oregon and manage about 4.6 million acres across Malheur, Grant and Harney Counties in Oregon and a small portion of Elko County, Nevada. The Baker Field Office is located in Baker City and includes approximately a 1/2 million acres spanning eight counties in Oregon and Washington. The Vale District also has plentiful opportunities for quiet reflection, exploration, education, and adventure. Whether you are seeking the solitude of the wilderness in Hells Canyon, fly fishing on the Owyhee River or taking a trip into the past at the National Historic Oregon Trail Interpretive Center, the Vale District is home to a diverse and robust set of attractions and opportunities for recreation.   Open map in a new window   Recreation Sites Search by

Plants, whether wild or planted in your garden, are highly adapted to specific conditions. They’re specialized to respond to temperature, light, precipitation, soils, the presence of insects and pollinators, and the length of the growing season. As environmental conditions change in a particular place, plants will either adapt or die out. Flowering plants can adapt by blooming earlier or later in the season. Tree species may start to appear in new places outside their normal range, such as more southern varieties moving farther north as warming temperatures create the necessary growing conditions. New types of flowers or vegetables survive in home gardens as the growing season, amount of rain, and soil conditions change. If a plant cannot adapt, it will suffer the consequences and no longer be able to survive in a particular location. pages.text: Velociraptor’s new cousin is a raptor unlike any seen before | National Geographic SCIENCE Velociraptor’s new cousin is a raptor unlike any seen before Shri rapax had bigger claws and potentially a stronger bite than its Hollywood relative. But paleontologists still don’t know the whereabouts of its head, which went missing. The newly named raptor Shri rapax was smuggled by poachers, rescued from the black market, and then, sometime following a CT-scan in 2016, its skull went missing. Photograph by Thierry Hubin, Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences By Riley Black Published July 29, 2025 Sometime before 2010, in the red sands of Mongolia’s Gobi Desert brimming with fossils, poachers excavated and stole the exquisite skeleton of a carnivorous dinosaur. They smuggled the fossil out of the country and onto the black market. It passed through private collections in Japan and England and was eventually acquired by the French fossil company Eldonia. In 2016, one of the fossil’s owners had the dinosaur’s skull and four vertebrae CT-scanned at a Belgian museum, but sometime later the head and neck went missing. Their whereabouts remain unknown to scientists. Negotiations between the fossil company, paleontologists, and government officials led to the return of the dinosaur’s body to Mongolia, where it could be cared for and studied, a raptor unlike any seen before. Now, this headless, extra-sharp relative of Velociraptor finally has a name: Shri rapax . A police vehicle was set on fire in Gopalganj district, where the banned student wing of Hasina's Awami League party clashed with security forces. Nationwide protests by pro-Hasina activists started a day after the former leader said she had requested a passport to return to Bangladesh from exile in India. The demonstrations by the student wing, called Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL), are seen as the first organised show of force by Hasina's supporters since she was ousted in August 2024 following a huge uprising against her rule . Reuters Sheikh Hasina was ousted in 2024 following weeks of mass protests Traffic was disrupted in some parts of the country as protesters tried to set up roadblocks using burning tyres. Several passenger vehicles were also set on fire in various parts of Bangladesh in the run up to the protest. pages.text: Visit Kuélap, a Peruvian Archaeological Site a Millennium Older Than Machu Picchu | National Geographic TRAVEL BEST OF THE WORLD Visit Kuélap, a Peruvian Archaeological Site a Millennium Older Than Machu Picchu The remote region north of Lima is also a paradise for lovers of mummies, wildlife, and orchids. At more than 2,500 feet, the Gocta waterfall, near the village of Cocachimba in northern Peru, is one of the world’s tallest. Ernesto Benavides By Heather Jasper Published October 20, 2026 Although the pre-Incan fortress of Kuélap is almost a thousand years older than Machu Picchu, it gets only a fraction of the crowds. The Chachapoya people built the citadel in northern Peru around the year 500 A.D. on a narrow fin of limestone high above the Utcubamba River—not unlike Machu Picchu’s perch above the Vilcanota River. Visit in 2027 to see new exhibits in the Apu Chuillaxa visitors’ center and walk a new trail in Malcapampa , an active archaeological site that has been newly opened to the public. ( See all 25 of the destinations that made our list of the best places to visit in 2027. ) When to Go The warm, rainy season arrives in the cloud forests of this part of Peru in November and lasts until April. More than a thousand orchid species are in bloom and the waterfalls thunder with extra volume. A cooler dry season from May through October offers better road conditions and drier trails, making it easier to visit archaeological sites around Kuélap. They like exploring tight dark places, undeterred by mud and whatever may be lurking. Give a caver a task to do, while down in a cave’s depths, and they will stay underground for hours and come back again a few weeks later to do it again. My former employer won’t issue me a corrected Form W-2. What should I do? Answer If by the end of February, your Form W-2, Wage and Tax Statement has not been corrected by your employer after you attempted to have your employer or payer issue a corrected form, you can request that an IRS representative initiate a Form W-2 complaint. Covered nonexempt workers are entitled to a minimum wage of not less than $7.25 per hour effective July 24, 2009. Overtime pay at a rate not less than one and one-half times the regular rate of pay is required after 40 hours of work in a workweek. FLSA Minimum Wage : The federal minimum wage is $7.25 per hour effective July 24, 2009. Many states also have minimum wage laws. In cases where an employee is subject to both state and federal minimum wage laws, the employee is entitled to the higher minimum wage. FLSA Overtime : Covered nonexempt employees must receive overtime pay for hours worked over 40 per workweek (any fixed and regularly recurring period of 168 hours – seven consecutive 24-hour periods) at a rate not less than one and one-half times the regular rate of pay.
